event.firm_key: MOUNTAIN ROSE INC DBA MOUNTAIN ROSE HERBS
event.recalling_firm: Mountain Rose Inc. dba Mountain Rose Herbs
event.initial_firm_notification: Two or more of the following: Email, Fax, Letter, Press Release, Telephone, Visit

products.product_description: Fennel Whole Seed was packaged in a clear plastic bag or poly-woven bags sold in bulk form, net weight ranges from 4 ounces to 50 pounds, sold under Mountain Rose Herbs brand. The label is read in parts: "***Fennel Seed Whole ***NET WT *** Origin: Egypt *** MOUNTAIN ROSE HERBS***EUGENE, OR 97402 ***".
products.product_quantity: 552/4 oz. bags; 351/8 oz bags; 1791 lbs. of bulk packages in various sizes
products.reason_for_recall: Fennel Whole Seed is recalled due to a potential for contamination with Salmonella.
